output.reason: Evidence supports the policy aspect: foreclosure/pre-closure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding are to be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower. However, the “RBI direction says no prepayment charges may be levied” is only evidenced for a specific scenario: a Tier 4 UCB must not levy prepayment charges on certain floating rate business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises (with or without co-obligant(s)). The evidence does not establish that this applies to the particular “case” referenced in the claim (e.g., whether the loan is a term loan vs. floating rate, and whether the borrower fits the defined categories).
